params.body:
Sweep with Server-Timing over 49 pages: two overviews stood out.

- /orders and /orders/sold: 819 ms and 225 ms, 178 queries for twenty rows. Each row loaded relation, vehicle, manufacturer, model, creating user, the latest transport, the contract and summed the extras, all lazily; ShowTransport counted the dealer's transport settings per row; and the controller logged in at RealGarant. Now: one eager load of those relations, extra_price from the loaded relation, ShowTransport memoised per dealer for the request, isConfigured() instead of a login.
- /exports (classic bidding list): 326 ms, 135 queries. Rows touched vehicle.primary_photo, the winning bid and the highest bid with dealer or merchant, lazily. Eager-loaded.

Expected: both under 120 ms and under 40 queries. I re-measure after deploy.
params.title: Orders and exports overviews: 178 and 135 queries to a handful
